title: The Great Skyward Plunge
idea: In the shimmering cloud-kingdom of Solara, young otter mechanic Pip and his spark-tailed fox companion race to calibrate the colossal Sun-Lift before the critical autumn equinox on the twenty-seventh. If the city's altitude gauge climbs, Solara harnesses infinite radiant energy; if it falls, the floating realm plunges into the foggy abyss below. With time running out, Pip discovers their grumpy rival’s sabotage isn’t malicious—it is a desperate maneuver to dodge a secret airborne storm, leaving the city's direction hanging on a single lever.
visual: A whimsical solarpunk floating archipelago bathed in warm violet and teal neon light, featuring a determined young otter in leather flight goggles grasping a massive bronze lever beside a glowing robotic fox. The mood is exhilarating and magical, with dramatic autumn clouds swirling beneath soaring wooden airships.
